create_redis_conf: create a RedisConf dataclass to configure Redis host, port, db, password, ssl, and mock settings
create_enqueue_conf: create an EnqueueConf dataclass to configure job timeout, ttl, result_ttl, failure_ttl, and job_id
create_rq_launcher_conf: create an RQLauncherConf dataclass to configure the RQ launcher with enqueue, queue, and redis settings
review_redis_conf: review the RedisConf dataclass fields for host, port, db, password, ssl, ssl_ca_certs, and mock options
summarize_rq_launcher_conf: summarize the RQLauncherConf dataclass that registers the rq launcher in the hydra launcher config group
